project.name: KHKD - Hairworm De Nhay Nuoc
project.description: Vietnamese science-horror Reel — giun horsehair dieu khien de nhay xuong nuoc
project.story: The horsehair worm (Spinochordodes tellinii) is a parasite that infects crickets and grasshoppers. The worm larva enters the host through drinking water, grows inside the host's body until it's longer than the host itself by coiling, then injects neurochemicals that hijack the cricket's brain — forcing it to seek out and jump into water on cue. Once submerged, the worm emerges from the cricket's body and swims away to mate, leaving the cricket drowning.
